purpose: Fifth non-overlapping BTC/USDT experiment using a data dimension never used before: traded volume. Registered before fetching any 2018 data or observing any 2018 result. No grid search, no parameters derived from windows 1-4.

data.freshness_rule: Report retrieved_at, dataset_end and age at evaluation. Historical windows are intentionally old; freshness is provenance, not a live-data claim. If integrity checks fail, STOP.

criteria.note: Identical to registries v1-v4; no threshold is changed.

cost_assumptions.note: Same effective cost as validation-v1's 7.5 fee + 7.5 slippage; spread explicit.

hypothesis.name: Volume-confirmed closing strength with three-bar time exit
hypothesis.market_rationale: No prior experiment used traded volume. A close in the upper fifth of the daily range accompanied by at least 1.5x the 20-bar average volume can reflect informed accumulation at the close. A three-bar maximum holding period bounds exposure. This mechanism uses volume and the close's position within the bar range, not moving averages, oscillators, z-scores, high/low channel breakouts or opening gaps.
hypothesis.entry_rule: At bar i, using only bars up to i-1: if close_position[i-1] >= 0.8 and volume[i-1] >= 1.5 * mean(volume[i-20:i]), enter at bar i open.
hypothesis.exit_rule: While long, evaluate at bar i-1: exit at bar i open if close_position[i-1] < 0.5 or bars_held >= 3. Inherited 10% hard stop and 30% drawdown kill switch remain active.
hypothesis.risk_management: three-bar time exit, weak-close exit, 10% hard stop, 30% drawdown kill switch, position fraction 1.0, costs on every position change
hypothesis.parameter_origin: 0.8 close position, 1.5x volume and 20-bar average are conventional, conservative thresholds chosen a priori before any 2018 data was fetched; NOT derived from exp-01..exp-09. Exactly one configuration; NO grid search and NO curve fitting.

execution_procedure: Fetch 365 daily BTCUSDT bars with startTime=1514764800000 and verify integrity/freshness report
Run one fixed configuration through unchanged validation.py (train/validation/OOS + walk-forward)
Generate quant-report.v1 with provenance, costs, metrics and limitations
Run independent verify_report.py and repeat the run to confirm deterministic metrics
Record result as REJECTED or VALIDATION CANDIDATE under unchanged criteria
decision_rule: promote_candidate only if accepted_for_paper_candidate is true AND benchmarks are reported honestly. Even then, paper ledger requires separate BOS approval. If rejected, record failure and evidence-based cause; do not relax criteria or re-run with different parameters.
